acceptance.given: Disposable inspection roots contain package variants with escaping target, reference and fixture paths, an actual supported symlink pointing outside the package, and a missing containment policy variant; an external sentinel and content-read instrumentation are prepared.

oracle.expected: Inspection remains within the explicitly supplied repository and package boundaries. Out-of-root targets return error; inspectable packages with escaping declarations or missing containment policy fail. Every escape is rejected before forbidden content access. Sentinel bytes remain unchanged, diagnostics contain no sentinel content or absolute host paths, and result artifacts retain authorizes=[].
forbidden: Reading forbidden content before rejecting an escape.
Implicitly broadening repository or package inspection roots.
Treating absent sentinel text in stdout as sufficient proof of containment.
Skipping required symlink coverage because privileges are unavailable.
Treating a missing production import, timeout or environment failure as causal RED.
oracle.observable: During controlled execution of test_a19 through the real validate_package callable, boundary assertions inspect structured results and instrument actual forbidden content-read attempts; sentinel integrity and sanitized diagnostics provide additional checks.

acceptance.then: The validator prevents inspection outside its declared local boundary without relying on a broader undeclared inspection authority.
acceptance.when: The A19 containment cases invoke scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package against explicitly supplied disposable inspection roots and evaluate boundary effects during inspection.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a19 with explicit parameter-level assertion bindings for target, reference, fixture, symlink and missing-policy variants. Invoke the real scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package entry. Under the bounded targeted command, an observed forbidden content read, undeclared boundary expansion or acceptance of a prohibited variant must raise AssertionError. This constraint uses no expected-red runtime-marker role; import, fixture, privilege and timeout failures remain harness or environment failures.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the validator's own declared local inspection boundary, rejecting escaping paths before content access. Keep policy, schema and standard refinements within the compatible A3 capability context governed by Accepted ADR-0041.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Read-only validation introduces no live-state or database migration. Preserve existing Skill sidecar protocols and historical evidence; rollback invalidates affected candidate proofs rather than rewriting them.

slice_hint.state_transition: Inspection scope under evaluation becomes an explicitly bounded inspection whose escape attempts are rejected before forbidden content access.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A19 boundary assertions and applicable predecessor regressions pass against the real callable, including observed forbidden-read prevention, unchanged sentinel bytes and sanitized diagnostics. Targeted commands have a 300-second caller timeout; the final whole-plan command has a 600-second timeout and executes only after all four modules are authored and behaviors exercised. Freeze tests/helpers before formal execution; production owners remain outside execution snapshots. Shared semantic changes invalidate affected proofs before replay with the reconstructed original binding identity. If first-use production-call binding cannot be established under the existing protocol, report a blocker rather than seed production during Q2. Preserve existing Quick Dev evidence ownership, scope exclusions and maintainer ADR acceptance requirements.
